purpose: Predeclared six-case evaluation of returned question spans and missing-detail blanks. These are original synthetic questions and notes, not real application materials.
mappingRule: A returned coverage part maps to an expected ask only when its promptQuote contains the entire declared promptSpan as a case-sensitive literal substring. No paraphrase or semantic matching is performed. A returned part can map to multiple asks; such merges are reported separately.
detailRule: For a mapped known ask, count whether any returned mapped part has a nonempty proposed value; this does not check correctness. For a mapped missing ask, require every mapped value to be empty. Omitted or unmapped missing asks are unassessed, never passes. A nonempty part spanning both known and missing asks is flagged without claiming which fact the value asserts.
